column1: # Dialog cerita — dicocokkan dari log OCR overlay translator user (sesi 28-29 Juli 2026).
# Adegan: laboratorium Chiloveig & Ateraxis, kontak Asteria-Beluga (M16),
# pengepungan Mokosh (Igla, Yoshiro, Vasily, Wulfgar, Klukai), dan
# duel Asteria-Dandelion melawan Graurizard.
# Nama tokoh, organisasi, dan istilah dunia tetap Inggris:
#   Chiloveig, Ateraxis, Asteria, Beluga, M16, Dandelion, Igla, Yoshiro, Vasily,
#   Wulfgar, Klukai, Lentine, Kenny, Nirvana, Lunasia, Graurizard, Vindicator's Mark,
#   Commander (dipakai "Komandan" karena itu sebutan, bukan nama), Doll, Mokosh.
# --- laboratorium: Chiloveig & Ateraxis ---
# --- Asteria menghubungi Beluga (M16) ---
# --- pengepungan Mokosh ---
Where is the Commander.
column2: Di mana Komandan.

column1: It can only be that person commanding.
column2: Hanya orang itu yang bisa memimpin.

column1: Hand over the Commander, you are not my targets.
column2: Serahkan Komandan, kalian bukan targetku.

column1: Such a troublesome battle just to find the Commander?
column2: Pertempuran serepot ini cuma untuk menemukan Komandan?

column1: After cleaning you up...
column2: Setelah membereskan kalian...

column1: Just forcing her back is enough.
column2: Cukup memaksanya mundur saja.

column1: Still enough to hold on.
column2: Masih cukup untuk bertahan.

column1: Vasily, can the logistics forces still keep up?
column2: Vasily, apakah pasukan logistik masih sanggup?

column1: The enemy has retreated, we won this wave of offensive!
column2: Musuh sudah mundur, kita menang di gelombang serangan ini!

column1: Currently tallying... the situation is not very optimistic.
column2: Sedang dihitung... situasinya tidak terlalu menggembirakan.

column1: Please protect the Commander well for me.
column2: Tolong lindungi Komandan baik-baik untukku.

column1: Then, now, the escort begins!
column2: Kalau begitu, sekarang pengawalan dimulai!

column1: They ordered us to stand by until the reassessment is completed.
column2: Mereka memerintahkan kita siaga sampai penilaian ulang selesai.

column1: I wonder what the military is planning.
column2: Aku penasaran apa yang direncanakan militer.

column1: Then what should we... do now?
column2: Lalu apa yang harus kita... lakukan sekarang?

column1: # --- Asteria & Dandelion melawan Graurizard ---
Finally... showed up.
column2: Akhirnya... muncul juga.

column1: After tracking for so long, it's time to end this.
column2: Setelah sekian lama melacak, saatnya mengakhiri ini.

column1: Anyway, I'm different from you, I'm very delicate.
column2: Lagi pula, aku beda denganmu, aku ini rapuh.

column1: Oh my, you're not allowed to hit me, okay?
column2: Aduh, kamu tidak boleh memukulku, ya?

column1: ...Hmph, to think you still remember that boring stuff.
column2: ...Hmph, tak kusangka kamu masih ingat hal membosankan itu.

column1: (Asteria finally understood her a little.)
column2: (Asteria akhirnya sedikit memahaminya.)

column1: (Dandelion watched leisurely from the side.)
column2: (Dandelion menonton santai dari samping.)

column1: Don't just stand there watching the show! Get over here and support me properly!
column2: Jangan cuma berdiri nonton! Ke sini dan dukung aku dengan benar!

column1: Y-Yes... Does Miss Asteria mind physical contact?
column2: I-Iya... Apa Nona Asteria keberatan dengan sentuhan fisik?

column1: Alright, alright, relax, take a deep breath.
column2: Ya, ya, santai, tarik napas dalam-dalam.

column1: Prepare to perish... creature that shouldn't exist here.
column2: Bersiaplah binasa... makhluk yang seharusnya tidak ada di sini.

column1: The "Vindicator's Mark" will not play a dirge of mourning for you—
column2: Vindicator's Mark tidak akan memainkan lagu duka untukmu—
